notes:
{幾何|きか} is the Japanese term for geometry, the branch of mathematics dealing with shapes, sizes, and spatial relationships.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{幾|いく}→幾〜：00444_iku⟧: how many, some
- ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧: what
The term comes from classical Chinese and originally meant 'how much/many'.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幾何|きか}⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧: geometry (as a field of study)
- {幾何|きか}⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: geometric, geometrical
- ⟦{平面|へいめん}→平面：20096_heimen⟧{幾何|きか}: plane geometry
- ⟦{立体|りったい}→立体：18797_rittai⟧{幾何|きか}: solid geometry
- ⟦{解析|かいせき}→解析：16075_kaiseki⟧{幾何|きか}: analytic geometry
- ⟦ユークリッド→ユークリッド：noentry⟧{幾何|きか}⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧: Euclidean geometry

- ⟦{代数|だいすう}→代数：05145_daisuu⟧: algebra
- ⟦{解析|かいせき}→解析：16075_kaiseki⟧: analysis (calculus)
- ⟦{図形|ずけい}→図形：04036_zukei⟧: shape, figure
- ⟦{三角形|さんかくけい}→三角形：05436_sankakukei⟧: triangle
- ⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧: circle

USAGE:
In everyday contexts, {幾何|きか}⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (geometric) is more commonly used than {幾何|きか} alone, as in {幾何|きか}⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧ (geometric pattern).
